decoded.meaning: An escape record at an UNASSIGNED kind (0x17), sitting where a label could have sat. An element is read by its KIND and never by its position (RFC-0027 5.1): this is not a label, and a core MUST NOT read its 2-byte payload as one. A forwarder steps over it by its declared length and relays the frame - the node least likely to implement a kind is exactly the node that must still step over it (RFC-0018 8).
decoded.note: The paired negative of path-label/label-wrong-length: kind and length are two clauses and they get two vectors, because a core that enforces only one of them passes a vector that merges them (RFC-0024 9.4). In KEY context both are refused anyway - any escape record makes a PATH inadmissible as a path_lookup_key (RFC-0027 amendment 5).
